# Stanley Systems

> Stanley Systems is built for owner-led service businesses that already have work, customers, invoices, estimates, goodwill, and repeat-job opportunity — but are losing money through office gaps. Stanley Systems installs practical office systems that turn more of that existing demand into collected cash, reviews, referrals, repeat work, and cleaner follow-up.

## Core Offers

- Free calculator: helps a service business owner estimate how much money is being delayed or lost through invoicing and office workflow drag. Canonical URL: https://stanley-systems.com/invoicing-delay-cash-flow-calculator
- Cash Flow Assessment: a $97 assessment that maps where office work is leaking money and shows which billing, follow-up, review, referral, or repeat-customer systems should be installed first. Canonical URL: https://stanley-systems.com/workflow-audit
- Systems Installation Sprint: a $1,500 focused installation sprint after the assessment that builds the approved systems your team can use. Canonical URL: https://stanley-systems.com/systems-installation-sprint
- Cashflow Control System: installs billing, invoice movement, payment follow-up, job-detail handoffs, and cash visibility workflows. Canonical URL: https://stanley-systems.com/systems/cashflow-control
- Repeat Revenue System: installs past-customer follow-up, review asks, referral asks, missed-call recovery, and repeat-work workflows. Canonical URL: https://stanley-systems.com/systems/repeat-revenue
- Optional ongoing control: available when a business needs Stanley Systems to keep improving and controlling the installed workflow after the sprint.

## Problems Stanley Systems Solves

Stanley Systems helps service business owners stop money leaks caused by:

- missed calls and weak callback routing
- late invoices and finished work sitting unpaid
- forgotten estimate follow-up
- poor handoffs between field work and office work
- payment follow-up that depends on memory
- weak review capture
- referral leakage
- past customers nobody contacts again
- disconnected tools that force owners to manage the workflow manually

## Best Fit Customers

Stanley Systems is a strong fit for owner-led service businesses that have real demand but weak office systems. Good-fit businesses include contractors, field service companies, marine service businesses, home service companies, specialty trades, and small service teams where the owner still feels the drag of missed follow-up, delayed billing, and disconnected tools.

## AI and Office Automation

Stanley Systems uses practical AI-assisted office automation where it makes the workflow faster and more reliable. The public promise is not “AI for AI’s sake.” The promise is cleaner office execution: faster billing, better follow-up, better handoffs, more review and referral opportunities, and systems the team can actually use.

## Cash Flow / Reviews / Referrals

Stanley Systems installs systems around the cash and customer follow-up already inside the business:

- Cash flow acceleration: get job details captured, invoices out, payment follow-up moving, and open balances visible.
- Review capture: ask happy customers while the job is still fresh.
- Referral capture: turn goodwill into a direct referral path instead of hoping customers remember.
- Repeat revenue: contact past customers before competitors do.
